rationale: The agent properly authenticated the user via full name + zip and acted only on the user’s orders. It correctly identified the laptop and watch orders, fetched product variants, and, for the laptop, explicitly confirmed the exact change before modifying the order, then reported the result accurately. However, for the watch, the agent executed an order-changing write (switching to the black-dial/leather variant) without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation from the user, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any write. The address change request could not be completed because no NYC address was saved in the profile and the user declined to provide one; this is acceptable. The lack of pre-write confirmation on the watch modification is sufficient to fail the pass bar.
